name: Enterprise Regulatory Authorization Case and Evidence Binding
constraints: WM-POL-004 owns application-to-decision case lifecycle and never owns current permission state.
WM-XCT-017 owns credentials or documents that evidence a grant without creating it.
WM-ECO-022 commercial entitlement and WM-KNW-003 IP rights remain separate from public-authority permission.
Favourable case outcome changes a grant only when the competent authority register records the effect.
Renewal, variation, suspension, revocation and surrender cases correlate to grant transitions without inferring them.
The enterprise record is a source-qualified mirror with observation time, source as-of and freshness.
holds: WM-POL-014 lacks a usable current specification and must not be repurposed automatically.
Independent Grok review and frozen audit remain pending.
